'''2007 Georgia State Championship Brian Rippetoe LS An Unusual Amount Of Fear''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Rippetoe]] at [[2007 Georgia State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' This is not the wipe you are looking for.
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
